India.emergency_instruction: Call 112 for immediate danger to life, including life-threatening mental-health crises or medical emergencies in India.
India.mental_health_details: 24/7 Toll-Free National Mental Health Helpline, available across 20+ languages.
India.non_emergency_advice: Consult your university health clinic or student counseling center for routine mental wellness guidance.
India.accessibility_warning: Crisis helplines in other nations (such as US/Canada 988 or UK 111) cannot be dialed from India. Please use the verified Indian numbers above.

United States.emergency_name: General Emergency Services (Police, Fire, Emergency Medical)
United States.emergency_instruction: Call 911 for immediate danger to life, including life-threatening mental-health crises. Note: 911 is general emergency dispatch, whereas 988 is dedicated to mental-health crisis support.
United States.mental_health_details: Available 24/7 across the United States in English & Spanish. Free and confidential support for anyone experiencing emotional distress or suicidal crisis.
United States.non_emergency_advice: Call 211 for local community health, social services, and non-emergency support referrals.
United States.accessibility_warning: 988 is a dedicated mental-health crisis lifeline; it is NOT a general emergency number. For immediate danger to life, dial 911.

Canada.emergency_instruction: Call 911 for immediate danger to life, including life-threatening mental-health crises. 911 is general emergency dispatch; 988 is dedicated to mental-health crisis support.
Canada.mental_health_details: Available 24/7 across Canada in English & French. Free, confidential suicide prevention and emotional crisis support.
Canada.tertiary_mental_health_service: Hope for Wellness Help Line (Indigenous Peoples)
Canada.non_emergency_advice: Call 811 for provincial non-emergency health information and nurse triage.
Canada.accessibility_warning: 988 is a dedicated mental-health crisis helpline; it is NOT a general emergency number. For immediate danger to life, dial 911.

United Kingdom.emergency_instruction: Call 999 (or 112) for immediate danger to life, including life-threatening mental-health emergencies across the UK. 999 is UK general emergency dispatch; NHS 111 is for non-emergency medical advice.
United Kingdom.primary_mental_health_service: UK Regional Services (England: NHS 111 / Scotland: NHS 24 / Wales: 111 Opt 2 / NI: Lifeline NI)
United Kingdom.mental_health_details: Regional NHS & Crisis Pathways: • England: NHS 111 mental-health option. • Scotland: NHS 24 on 111. • Wales: NHS 111 Wales (Select Option 2). • Northern Ireland: Lifeline NI (0808 808 8000) or local HSC Trust services (the England NHS 111 pathway does not apply in Northern Ireland).
United Kingdom.non_emergency_advice: Non-emergency health advice is region-specific: NHS 111 in England; NHS 24 on 111 in Scotland; NHS 111 Wales in Wales; and GP Out-of-Hours in Northern Ireland.
United Kingdom.accessibility_warning: Regional Notice: The NHS 111 mental-health pathway is specific to England and Wales/Scotland via distinct NHS bodies; it does NOT operate in Northern Ireland. In Northern Ireland, use Lifeline NI (0808 808 8000) or local HSC Trust services. NHS 111 is for non-emergency health advice and mental health triage; it is NOT a general emergency number. For immediate danger to life across the UK, dial 999.

Australia.emergency_instruction: Call 000 (Triple Zero) for immediate danger to life, including life-threatening mental-health crises. Lifeline 13 11 14 is dedicated to mental health crisis support.
Australia.mental_health_details: 24/7 crisis support and suicide prevention services across Australia.
Australia.non_emergency_advice: Call healthdirect at 1800 022 222 for 24/7 registered nurse health advice.
Australia.accessibility_warning: Lifeline 13 11 14 is dedicated to mental health crisis support; it is NOT a general emergency number. For immediate danger to life, dial 000.

Other / International.emergency_instruction: Contact your national emergency services number for immediate danger to life, including life-threatening mental-health emergencies.
Other / International.mental_health_details: Free, confidential crisis support in 130+ countries. Find local crisis lines by selecting your country.
Other / International.non_emergency_advice: Consult your local university health center or primary healthcare clinic.
Other / International.accessibility_warning: Crisis helplines are strictly country-specific and cannot be connected across national borders.

England.emergency_instruction: Call 999 (or 112) for immediate danger to life, including life-threatening mental-health emergencies or imminent self-harm. 999 is UK emergency services dispatch; NHS 111 is for non-emergency health advice and mental health triage.
England.mental_health_details: NHS 24/7 urgent mental health triage across England. Select the mental health option to reach local NHS trust mental health teams.
England.non_emergency_advice: Call NHS 111 for non-emergency medical advice and clinician triage in England when it is not a 999 emergency.
England.regional_notice: England-Specific: The NHS 111 mental-health option routes to local NHS mental health trusts across England.
England.accessibility_warning: NHS 111 is for non-emergency health advice and mental health triage in England; it is NOT a general emergency number. For immediate danger to life, dial 999.

Scotland.emergency_instruction: Call 999 (or 112) for immediate danger to life, including life-threatening mental-health emergencies or imminent self-harm. 999 is UK emergency services dispatch; NHS 24 is for non-emergency health advice.
Scotland.mental_health_details: NHS 24 on 111 provides urgent care and mental health triage across Scotland (24/7). Breathing Space is also available at 0800 83 85 87 (evenings/weekends).
Scotland.non_emergency_advice: Call NHS 24 on 111 for non-emergency medical advice in Scotland.
Scotland.regional_notice: Scotland-Specific: Non-emergency medical care and mental health triage in Scotland are operated by NHS 24 on 111.
Scotland.accessibility_warning: NHS 24 on 111 is for non-emergency health advice and mental health triage; it is NOT a general emergency number. For immediate danger to life, dial 999.

Wales.emergency_instruction: Call 999 (or 112) for immediate danger to life, including life-threatening mental-health emergencies or imminent self-harm. 999 is UK emergency services dispatch; NHS 111 Wales is for non-emergency health advice.
Wales.mental_health_details: NHS 111 Wales provides 24/7 urgent mental health support. Press 2 to speak directly to a local mental health practitioner across all health boards in Wales.
Wales.non_emergency_advice: Call NHS 111 Wales for urgent non-emergency medical advice.
Wales.regional_notice: Wales-Specific: Urgent mental health support in Wales is accessed by calling NHS 111 Wales and selecting Option 2.
Wales.accessibility_warning: NHS 111 Wales is for non-emergency health advice and mental health triage; it is NOT a general emergency number. For immediate danger to life, dial 999.

Northern Ireland.emergency_instruction: Call 999 (or 112) for immediate danger to life, including life-threatening mental-health emergencies or imminent self-harm. 999 is UK emergency services dispatch; Lifeline NI is for non-emergency mental-health crisis support.
Northern Ireland.primary_mental_health_service: Lifeline NI & Local HSC Trust Crisis Services
Northern Ireland.mental_health_details: Lifeline is the 24/7 regional crisis response helpline for Northern Ireland. Alternatively, contact your local Health and Social Care (HSC) Trust Crisis Response Team or GP Out-of-Hours.
Northern Ireland.tertiary_mental_health_service: Local HSC Trust Crisis Services / GP Out-of-Hours
Northern Ireland.tertiary_mental_health_number: Contact local Trust Crisis Team / GP Out-of-Hours
Northern Ireland.non_emergency_advice: Contact your local GP surgery or local HSC Trust GP Out-of-Hours service. The England NHS 111 telephone service does not operate in Northern Ireland.
Northern Ireland.regional_notice: Northern Ireland-Specific: The England NHS 111 telephone mental-health pathway does not operate in Northern Ireland. Students should connect with Lifeline NI (0808 808 8000) or their local HSC Trust Crisis Response Team.
Northern Ireland.accessibility_warning: Lifeline NI (0808 808 8000) is a dedicated crisis helpline; it is NOT a general emergency number. For immediate danger to life, dial 999.
